judged_text: Feed content is imported with no sanitization: CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub) is passed straight into TopicEmbed.import → PostCreator with cook_method raw_html, whose cook path returns the raw string untouched, and it is rendered via `raw post.cooked` in best.html.erb and on topic pages. adjudication.rationale: The diff adds feed import via `Jobs::PollFeed`, which does `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` and passes it to `TopicEmbed.import`. `TopicEmbed.import` creates a post with `PostCreator.new(... raw: absolutize_urls(url, contents), ... cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html], skip_validations: true)`. In `Post#cook`, `raw_html` returns `raw` directly (skipping the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline), and the embed view renders it as HTML via `<%= raw post.cooked %>`. Nothing in the diff sanitizes the feed HTML, so arbitrary/compromised feed markup (e.g., `<script>`, event handlers, iframes) can become stored XSS on the forum origin.
